prompt.v: Triangle ABC has its right angle at A. Which side is adjacent to angle B?

problems.text: side name: right A, angle B, third C, want adjacent
problems.explain: AB touches B and is not the hypotenuse: it runs from B to the right angle at A. (BC touches B too, but it is the hypotenuse, so it is never called adjacent.) So AB.

prompt.v: Triangle ABC has its right angle at A. Which side is the hypotenuse?

problems.text: side name: right A, angle B, third C, want hypotenuse
problems.explain: BC faces the right angle at A, and is the longest side. (The hypotenuse is named from the right angle, not from B, so it is the same whichever acute angle is used.) So BC.

problems.explain: PR faces the right angle at Q, and is the longest side. (The hypotenuse is named from the right angle, not from R, so it is the same whichever acute angle is used.) So PR.

prompt.v: Triangle PQR has its right angle at Q. Which side is opposite to angle R?

problems.text: side name: right Q, angle R, third P, want opposite
problems.explain: PQ is across the triangle from R: it is the one side that does not touch R. (PR does not touch Q, but it is the hypotenuse; opposite is named from R.) So PQ.
